functions.name: exp
functions.doc: e raised to the power x.

functions.name: floor
functions.doc: Round down to the nearest integer.

functions.name: ceil
functions.doc: Round up to the nearest integer.

functions.name: mod
functions.doc: Remainder of a divided by b (a modulo b).

functions.name: sign
functions.doc: -1, 0, or 1 by the sign of x.

functions.name: int
functions.doc: Truncate toward zero (drop the fractional part).

functions.name: atan2
functions.doc: Angle of the point (x, y) from the positive x-axis, in radians.

functions.name: get_year
functions.doc: Calendar year of the given time.

functions.name: get_month
functions.doc: Calendar month (1–12) of the given time.

functions.name: get_day
functions.doc: Day of month of the given time.

functions.name: occurs
functions.doc: 1 on the step an event fires, else 0.

functions.name: changed
functions.doc: 1 on the step x differs from its previous value, else 0.

functions.name: pv_factor
functions.doc: Present-value discount factor for a rate over n periods, 1/(1+rate)^n.

functions.name: annuity_factor
functions.doc: Present-value factor of a level annuity at a rate over n periods.

functions.name: table_min
functions.doc: Minimum value in a lookup table.

functions.name: table_max
functions.doc: Maximum value in a lookup table.

functions.name: column_count
functions.doc: Number of columns in a table.

functions.name: size_array
functions.doc: Number of elements in an array.

functions.name: get_element
functions.doc: The i-th element of an array (0-based).

functions.name: interp_array
functions.doc: Linear interpolation of x through the (xs, ys) breakpoints.

functions.name: dot_product
functions.doc: Dot product of two equal-length arrays.

functions.name: argmin_where
functions.doc: Index of the smallest value among members where mask ≠ 0.

functions.name: argmax_where
functions.doc: Index of the largest value among members where mask ≠ 0.

timeRefs.name: elapsed
timeRefs.doc: Time elapsed since the run start (in the model's time unit).

timeRefs.name: days_in_month
timeRefs.doc: Number of days in the current month.

timeRefs.name: elapsed_months
timeRefs.doc: Whole months elapsed since the run start.

timeRefs.name: elapsed_years
timeRefs.doc: Whole years elapsed since the run start.
